name: bar-list
purpose: A ranked list of named values: each row is a tinted bar whose length is the value against the largest one, with the name inside the bar and the formatted value in a right-aligned column. It reads as a list, not a chart — no axes, no grid — so it suits top-N breakdowns inside a card, where a horizontal `chart` would spend its width on an axis gutter.
useWhen: Top-N breakdowns inside a card: top paths, top countries, top user agents, top rules triggered.
A ranking where the name matters as much as the size, and names are long enough to need the bar's full width.
Rows that lead somewhere — a filtered view of that path or country — via `href` or `item-click`.
avoidWhen: Several series per category, or values over time → use `chart`.
A share of a whole where the parts sum to 100% → use `donut-chart`.
One value against a limit (quota, usage) → use `progress`.
related: chart` — horizontal bars with an axis, for comparing several series per category.
donut-chart` — the share view of the same breakdown when the parts sum to a whole.
chart-card` — the box a BarList sits in on a dashboard.
bestPractices: Keep it to about ten rows; fold the tail into an "Other" row in the data rather than scrolling.
Leave `sort` on `descending` for rankings; use `none` only when the order itself carries meaning (pipeline steps, weekdays).
Pass the same `formatValue` as the chart beside it so a number reads the same in both.
Give interactive rows a destination the user expects — a filtered view of that item — not a detail drawer of the whole list.

props.name: items
props.doc: Rows to rank; each item is `{ id?: string; name: string; value: number; href?: string }`. An item with `href` renders as a link.

props.name: sort
props.doc: Row order; `none` keeps the order of `items`.

props.name: color
props.doc: Hue of the bars: a categorical slot (1–6), `other`, or a status. The fill is that hue tinted over the surface.

props.name: clickable
props.doc: Renders rows without an `href` as buttons that emit `item-click`.

props.name: loading
props.doc: Renders Skeleton rows in place of the list.

props.name: emptyTitle
props.doc: Title of the empty state shown when `items` is empty. Empty uses the locale catalog (`No data available`).

events.name: item-click
events.notes: A row activated — a clickable row, or a link row (the link still navigates). `item` is the consumer's own item object.
